notes: The chain is quoted from «رجال الكشي», a source known by its title, in a modern compilation (rule 11): a ruling is needed; the compiler is not a transmitter of this work
The «…» after «يونس بن عبد الرحمن» marks an omission in the quotation: no names are supplied for it (rule 9); the text goes straight to «قال: حدثني هشام بن الحكم»
«[-/7]» is a number and is left out; the Imam is the last link, named after «سمع» (rule 5)
